Array methods: map, filter, reduce,
find, some, every

map transforms each element, filter selects matches, reduce accumulates, find returns the first
match, some tests any and every tests all.
map හැම item එකම transform කරනවා. filter condition එකට ගෙැළJපන items Jතහෝරනවා.
reduce එක result එකකට එකතු කරනවා. find මුල් match එක Jදයි. some එකක්වත්, every

Interview question: What is the difference between map and forEach?

Answer: map returns a new array of mapped values; forEach returns undefined and is used
for side effects.
Remember: Transform, select, accumulate, find, any, all.
Practice: Use filter then map to get the names of products under 100.
